description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's unpack-objects functionality, particularly under conditions involving large objects and memory limitations. It defines functions to prepare repositories, runs tests to verify behavior, and processes trace logs.

methods.name: prepare_dest
methods.description: Initializes a bare Git repository and sets the core.bigFileThreshold configuration.

methods.name: check_fsync_events
methods.description: Processes the trace output to verify fsync-related events.
